title: Solar systems.
officialText:
The construction, installation, alterations and repair of systems, equipment and appliances intended to capture
and utilize solar energy for space heating or cooling, domestic hot water heating, swimming pool heating or process heating shall be
in accordance with the New York City Mechanical Code and this code.
SECTION PC 613
TEMPERATURE CONTROL DEVICES AND VALVES
